component.name: Music
component.summary: Play the songs in your Music folder

description.p: Music plays the songs in the Music folder in your home folder. Browse them by song, album, artist or folder, make playlists, like songs, and shrink Music to a mini player that stays on top of your other windows.

It reads titles, cover art and lyrics from the files themselves and keeps playlists as .m3u8 files in Music/Playlists, so any other player can open them. The media keys and the media controls in the taskbar work with it. Nothing is streamed or looked up online: no accounts and no tracking.
